title: 第15章 战气海六重第16章 优秀弟子
content_zh:
“哈哈哈！我看到了什么，居然有人要挑战我！”
尹海愣住了，而后大笑了起来，仿佛听到了世界上最可笑的事情似的。
他尹海虽然是个关系户，可当年也是一位外山正式弟子，并且如今的实力也是达到了气海境六重。
比绝大多数的正式弟子都要强很多。
哪怕是已经加入了宗门的正式弟子，也都不敢说来挑战他！
而今一个蝼蚁，居然都敢来挑战他了，这是觉得他尹海提不动刀了吗？
就连王林也都微愣：
“你确定要挑战他吗？”
“怎么，难道他的身份不够吗？”
林炎不解。
王林摇头：
“不是够，是绰绰有余。尹海是外山执事，身份比普通正式弟子要高一级，和外山优秀弟子地位相当。但你完全可以挑战一位外山正式弟子，这样更保险一些。”
尹海的实力可比普通外山弟子强得多。
而且林炎和尹海之间的恩怨已经不可调和，在生死台上尹海肯定会不惜代价想除掉林炎。
换做是普通外山弟子，即便林炎输了，对方也未必会想要置林炎于死地。
“我就挑战他！”
林炎眼神坚定。
如果他只是挑战普通外山弟子，哪怕赢了，长老多半也要权衡为了他得罪尹家值不值得。
只有石破天惊，才能得到长老重视！
“既然你诚心找死，那我成全你！”

尹海一脸森然，他正发愁没有光明正大的机会除掉林炎呢，这小子居然主动来送死了。
这件事很快被上报了上去。
正常来说，这种约战需要走流程，最起码几天的时间，可由于林炎所作的事情太过石破天惊，所以很快就有长老现身。
“有意思，一个养气九重，居然要挑战气海六重的外山执事，老夫在外山这么多年，也还是第一次遇到。”
这次来主持约战的，是外山长老马保国，乃是一位灵海境强者。
“你确定，要挑战一位外山执事？如果上了角斗场，那可就没有退路，直至分出生死！”
马保国开口。
“我若打败尹海，是否可以升为外山弟子？”
林炎询问。
“能不能升外山弟子，看你的表现，不过如果你能以养气九重打败气海六重，老夫可以做主给你外山弟子身份。”
马保国微微点头。
“好！”
有了这句话，林炎就放心了，他率先踏上角斗场的擂台。
尹海也随之踏上角斗场，而后马保国长老出手，以符文大阵封锁了角斗场的出口。
角斗场由阵法控制，一旦开启决斗模式，除非双方之中有一方身死，不然的话阵法不会轻易开启。
当然长老有特权可以强行开启，但长老一般不会做那种事。
毕竟上了角斗场，就要做好付出生命的准备。
“小畜生，你若乖乖的将你身上的秘密告知于我，我可以放你一条生路。”
尹海眼神炽热，盯着林炎。
“原来是看上了我身上的宝物啊，怪不得要对我赶尽杀绝！”
content_en:
"Hahaha! What did I see? Someone wants to challenge me!"
Yin Hai was stunned, and then laughed, as if he had heard the most ridiculous thing in the world.
Although he, Yin Hai, was a relative, he was also an official disciple of Waishan back then, and his current strength has reached the sixth level of Qi Sea Realm.
Much stronger than most formal disciples.
Even the formal disciples who have joined the sect dare not challenge him!
Now an ant actually dares to challenge him. Does this mean that he, Yin Haiti, can't move?
Even Wang Lin was slightly stunned:
"Are you sure you want to challenge him?"
"Why, isn't his identity enough?"
Lin Yan was puzzled.
Wang Lin shook his head:
"It's not enough, but more than enough. Yin Hai is the deacon of Waishan, and his status is one level higher than ordinary formal disciples, and his status is equivalent to that of outstanding disciples of Waishan. But you can definitely challenge a formal disciple of Waishan, which is safer."
Yin Hai's strength is much stronger than ordinary outside disciples.
Moreover, the grudge between Lin Yan and Yin Hai has become irreconcilable. On the stage of life and death, Yin Hai will definitely want to get rid of Lin Yan at any cost.
If it were an ordinary outsider disciple, even if Lin Yan lost, the opponent might not want to kill Lin Yan.
"I'll challenge him!"
Lin Yan's eyes were firm.
If he were just challenging an ordinary outsider disciple, even if he won, the elders would probably have to weigh whether it was worth offending the Yin family for him.
Only by breaking the ground can you get the attention of the elders!
"Since you sincerely seek death, then I will grant your wish!"
Yin Hai had a grim look on his face. He was worried that he wouldn't have an honest chance to get rid of Lin Yan, but this kid actually took the initiative to die.
The incident was reported quickly.
Normally, this kind of appointment would require a process, which would take at least a few days, but because what Lin Yan did was so earth-shattering, the elders showed up soon.
"It's interesting. A deacon of the ninth level of Qi Yang actually wants to challenge a deacon of the sixth level of the Qi Sea. This is the first time I have encountered him in the outer mountains for so many years."
The one who came to preside over the battle this time was Ma Baoguo, the elder of Waishan, who was a strong man in the spiritual sea realm.
"Are you sure you want to challenge an outsider? If you get into the arena, there will be no way out until life and death are determined!"
Ma Baoguo spoke.
"If I defeat Yin Hai, can I be promoted to an outside disciple?"
Lin Yan asked.
"Whether you can be promoted to an Outer Mountain Disciple depends on your performance, but if you can defeat the Sixth Level Qi Sea with the Ninth Level of Nourishing Qi, I can make the decision to give you the status of an Outer Mountain Disciple."
Ma Baoguo nodded slightly.
"Okay!"
With these words, Lin Yan felt relieved and took the lead in stepping onto the arena.
Yin Hai also stepped into the arena, and then Elder Ma Baoguo took action and blocked the exit of the arena with a rune array.
The arena is controlled by formations. Once the duel mode is activated, unless one of the two parties dies, the formations will not be activated easily.
Of course, the elders have the privilege to forcibly open it, but elders generally would not do that kind of thing.
After all, when you enter the arena, you must be prepared to sacrifice your life.
"Little beast, if you tell me your secrets obediently, I can let you live."
Yin Hai stared at Lin Yan with burning eyes.
"It turns out that you are interested in the treasures on my body. No wonder you want to kill me!"
